opening.argument: The presentation explains Lantern's custodial crypto-lending service by describing why someone might seek liquidity without selling Litecoin. It also makes clear that borrowing carries material conditions and risks: “If the price of your collateral goes down enough, the platform can liquidate it and forcefully sell the crypto,” and repayment is required to redeem the collateral. The discussion further identifies over-leveraging as more risky and states that Litecoin loans are limited to 40% LTV. Although viewers are offered “50 bips off” a Litecoin-backed loan after scanning a link and creating an account, that referral offer appears within an explanation of collateral exposure, liquidation, and repayment obligations, rather than evidence of deception or a completed loss.
